meta.author:
詞曲：周巽光、璽恩、曹之懿、陳州邦、謝思穎 、馬永蒂、湯國維
中譯英：王建玫

lines.a: 讚美是我的武器
lines.b: Praise is the weapon I wield

lines.a: 感謝就釋放神蹟
lines.b: Thanks bring signs and wonders

lines.a: 神的軍隊在前進
lines.b: God's army is marching on

lines.a: 跨越世代我們宣告
lines.b: Through every age, we now declare

lines.a: 神的國 降臨在 這土地
lines.b: Let Your Kingdom come upon this land

lines.a: 杖釋放智慧權柄
lines.b: Staff brings wisdom and command

lines.a: 劍啟動扭轉契機
lines.b: Sword can turn the tide at hand

lines.a: 爭戰靠兩代合力
lines.b: Two ages fight as one

lines.a: 同心就能擊潰仇敵
lines.b: Joined as one, we crush the foe

lines.a: 來高舉 主耶穌 聖名
lines.b: Come lift up the name of Jesus Christ

lines.a: We R One
我們同心合意 如父子聖靈
lines.b: In one accord - The Father, Son and Spirit, One

lines.a: We R One
我們都轉向 天父的心
lines.b: We all turn our hearts, To our Father's heart

lines.a: 我們謙卑 回轉 尋求祢旨意
lines.b: We humble ourselves, Turn back and seek Your will

lines.a: 讓咒詛 都離開 祢應許之地
lines.b: Let every curse now depart, From Your promised land

lines.a: We R One
我們彼此對齊 都放下自己
lines.b: Aligned as one, We all lay ourselves down

lines.a: We R One
我們都參與這 榮耀戰役
lines.b: We all take part, In this glorious fight

lines.a: 協同作戰 專注 聽主號令
lines.b: We fight as one, Focused on the Lord's command

lines.a: 杖劍合併 宣告 祢國度降臨
lines.b: Staff and sword unite, we declare, Let Your Kingdom come

lines.a: Stand together, We R One
杖劍合併, We R One
lines.b: Staff and sword, now We R One!

lines.a: Stand together, We R One
HEY HEY HEY HEY
Stand together, We R One
兩代合一, We R One
lines.b: Two as one, now We R One

lines.a: Stand together, We R One
HEY HEY HEY HEY
放下驕傲 以謙卑束腰
lines.b: Drop your pride; let a humble heart be your guide

lines.a: 彼此轉向 不要再內耗
lines.b: Turn to each other; leave all the strife behind

lines.a: 耐心傳承 為父的心不倚老賣老
lines.b: Fathers, pass the torch with patience—lay your pride aside

lines.a: 順服聆聽 年輕人不搞叛逆那套
lines.b: Young ones, hear and follow—do not turn or rebel inside

lines.a: Army of God 得著這世代為主燃燒
lines.b: Army of God, win this age; for the Lord we burn bright

lines.a: 十指緊扣 向天國標竿我們奔跑
lines.b: Hand in hand, toward the Kingdom mark, we run with all our might

lines.a: 復興時刻 杖與劍一路直搗
lines.b: Revival now—staff and sword break through the enemy line

lines.a: 我們同心 向這地齊心宣告
lines.b: Heart to heart, across this land, we rise and testify
